requirements.text: This system represents different types of vehicles.
A Vehicle has a position, a speed and a maximum speed.
Besides, it has an environment (with a value among “land”, “water” and “air”).
Finally, it can move for a given time.
Those are the features of a generic vehicle.
Then, we have land vehicles and marine vehicles as specific types of vehicles, where both have all the same features as a vehicle.
Finally, an amphibious vehicle can be both a land vehicle and a marine vehicle.
